Subject: Seniority placement & HC approval checklist — L4 through L6 variance

Team —

I ran through the Acme AI pipeline this morning and we have three near-term candidates where title placement is ambiguous (two hiring manager asks for manager track, one prefers IC but requests L6/Staff comp). I attached an updated HC_Checklist_v2 with the scorecard and proposed comp bands, plus a snapshot of current comp matrix.

Quick asks:
- Can the hiring committee sign off on the placement rules for the two manager-track requests versus the IC L6 ask?
- If we allow an L6 IC exception, do we require a +1 equity tranche or a comp band premium?
- Marcus — please confirm there’s available headcount in the FY27 hiring plan for this role (we discussed a reserve but I need confirmation).

I summarized candidate scenarios on the checklist; the key differences are scope (org-wide vs. cross-team), ownership expectations, and interview feedback for leadership. I used the latest placement guidelines doc (link below) when scoring.

If you can reply with a short signoff or a note by EOD tomorrow (Fri 5/28), I’ll proceed with offers and HR approvals.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Head of Talent Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: HC_Checklist_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), comp_matrix_snapshot.pdf (PDF)

Subject: Re: Seniority placement & HC approval checklist — L4 through L6 variance

Soojin —

Thanks for the clear breakdown. Quick thoughts after a skim:

- Candidate A (AM2027): HM recommends manager L5. Interview loop shows strong cross-team influence, but not full org manager scope. I lean toward L5 IC with a clear PM/EM handoff document rather than manager title.
- Candidate B (AM2051): HM wants manager L6. Feedback shows strong people leadership and prior org-building experience — seems borderline Staff Manager. I'm okay approving manager-track L6 if Marcus confirms HC.
- Candidate C (AM2103): Asks for L6 IC. Their IC impact is high, but compensation exceeds current L6 median. I'd be open to making a comp premium for 12 months (performance-based), not changing title immediately.

On the comp side: prefer equity tranche + performance milestone rather than permanent band stretch. Keeps internal equity cleaner.

Jonas
Jonas Weber
VP, Engineering
